thread:
anya: noticed the cost dashboard shows inflated cache credits when a session is sticky but routing retries mid-stream. small repro below.

miguel: can you paste the minimal repro?

anya: ```
session=svc-42
initial_route=eu-central
model=redwood-lite
prefetch_kv=100
tokens_total=150
fallback_after=110
fallback_model=redwood-small
```

lina: sounds like attribution lacks a token offset at handoff. we only emit route_handoff timestamp, not token index. billing prorates by session currently so it applies full credit.

product-sam: UX ask: add a "why negative" drilldown on tenant cards that shows routing spans and a confidence tag when heuristics are used.

miguel: engineering options: 1) router emits a small async telemetry event session_handoff with handoff_token_index + prefetch_kv, 2) router adds headers (x-handoff-token-index) on requests. i prefer async events to keep router minimal.

lina: agreed on async event. fallback: for older routers billing will estimate handoff index using timestamp + avg tokens/sec and mark allocations as "estimated". console should show an "est. error" badge.

anya: billing change: prorate prefetch credit to tokens < handoff_index and don't credit tokens after. reconcile nightly to update provisional numbers.

product-sam: UX details: - show provisional numbers with dotted style - show "Reconciled" badge after nightly job - tooltip exposing raw handoff event ids for support. also show "est. B1 10% (heuristic)" when estimated.

miguel: quick plan: router event + telemetry indexer = 1d, billing reconciliation job = 2d, console UX and toggle = 1d. ship behind FF and monitor top-10 tenant list to ensure negative savings disappear.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary for router-prefetch-metadata started -> 2/4 hosts updated :rocket:

lina: i'll add a tiny runbook for support explaining provisional vs reconciled numbers and how to collect event ids.

anya: i'll open a tiny PR with test vectors (handoff inside chunk + non-aligned offsets) and attach to rollout doc. closing once PR + FF validated. :thumbsup:
